description:
Build-time code generation: reads @Table entities and emits their mapper and
        repositories.

        Nothing here runs in a deployed application — it only ever executes inside javac.
        It lives in its own artifact so that it, and JavaPoet with it, can eventually be
        dropped from the runtime classpath. Today the runtime still depends on it at
        compile scope so that adding the extension keeps generating code with no extra
        setup; making that dependency `provided` is the one change needed to take both
        out of consuming applications, and is deliberately left for a release that can
        carry the migration note.
